Rescission Clause.
All orders, issuances, rules and
regulations or parts thereof inconsistent with this Executive Order are
hereby revoked or modified accordingly. However, this Executive Order
should complement Memorandum Order No. 175, as amended, which
provides for, among others, the creation of Project Monitoring Committees.
